name: GitHub Actions Tools
description: Installs tools for local GitHub Actions development: act (local runner) and actionlint (workflow linter).

install.description: Comma-separated list of tools to install (e.g. 'act'). When set, only the listed tools are installed. When empty (default), all tools are installed.

omit.description: Comma-separated list of tools to exclude (e.g. 'actionlint'). When set, the listed tools are skipped. Applied after 'install' filtering.

actVersion.description: Version of act to install, or 'latest'

actionlintVersion.description: Version of actionlint to install, or 'latest'
